claims: The Citizenship Clause of the 14th Amendment establishes birthright citizenship.
The Citizenship Clause of the 14th Amendment overruling the Dred Scott decision.
The Due Process Clause of the 14th Amendment prohibits states from depriving individuals of "life, liberty, or property, without due process of law".
The Equal Protection Clause of the 14th Amendment prohibits states from denying any person equal protection under the law.
The Privileges or Immunities Clause of the 14th Amendment prevents states from enacting laws that abridge the privileges of U.S. citizens.
Section 3 (Disqualification Clause) of the 14th Amendment prohibits anyone who engaged in insurrection or rebellion against the U.S. from holding federal or state office.
Section 5 of the 14th Amendment grants Congress the power to enforce these provisions through legislation.
The 14th Amendment replaced the Three-Fifths Compromise by counting all persons for representation.
